open_points.subject: Flow activation (K-08, Primary actions, M18)
open_points.text: "A read-only flow is activated by the kernel once proven" (K-08) vs separate action "activate a flow" with "the kernel activates a proven read-only version at once"
open_points.question: When exactly is a proven read-only flow version activated: automatically as part of compose/prove, only when an activate action is called, or both?
options: Automatic immediately after a version is proven read-only
Only on explicit activate action request (agent or owner asks)
Automatic on proof, and explicit activate can still create later activation records
open_points.default_guess: Automatic immediately after proof for read-only versions, with activate action mainly relevant to effectful versions.

open_points.subject: Actor attribution on kernel-made records (K-15 vs State 1 model fields)
open_points.text: K-15: "The owner's actions, each agent's and the kernel's own are distinguishable in every record" and "records name it as the actor"; but several kernel-produced records list no actor field (for example M08 AdmissionVerdict has `decided_at` only).
open_points.question: Must every persisted record explicitly carry an Actor value (including `kernel`), or is actor allowed to be implicit from record type/context for kernel-generated records?
options: Every persisted record has an explicit actor field when created/changed
Only records tied to user decisions carry explicit actor; kernel actor is implicit elsewhere
Mixed rule by model type, explicitly enumerated
open_points.default_guess: Add explicit actor fields for kernel-authored decision/event records so kernel steps cannot be mistaken for human actions.
